test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 20 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Fill in the blank with an appropriate option.

The sun ______ directly in the east and sets directly in the west.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'** i.e. **'Rises'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sun **"rises"** in the east and sets in the west.
 
• This is a **common phrase used to **describe the apparent movement of the sun across the sky due to the rotation of the earth.

Therefore, the **correct answer **is: 'The sun **rises** directly in the east and sets directly in the west.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Here's why the other options are incorrect:
 
 
• **"Sums": **This verb is used in the context of adding up numbers or amounts. It doesn't make sense in this context.
 
• **"Expands": **This verb means to increase in size, volume, quantity, or scope. It doesn't make sense to say the sun "expands" in the east.
 
• **"Elevates": **This verb means to raise or lift something up to a higher position. While the sun does appear to move higher in the sky after sunrise, the standard term used to describe this phenomenon is "rise", not "elevate".
